method: Values read by pixel position from four accuracy-vs-cost charts that the user supplied as screenshots on 2026-09-28 (planandtier-sonnet-5-5-charts/*.png). Captions and chart styling indicate Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 launch material; the source URL was not recorded. Cost axes are log scale; read values are approximate: about +/-1 point (+/-15 Elo) on score and +/-5% on cost. Effort labels on Sonnet 5.5 points are printed on the charts. Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5 points are unlabelled and are taken as low, medium, high, xhigh, max in cost order; the Opus 5.5 CursorBench points confirm this order against its system card (52.5 medium, 56.0 high and xhigh, 57.8 max; see planandtier-tier-research.json). Vendor data. GPT rows omitted.

models.sonnet: claude-sonnet-5-5 (what Claude Code's `sonnet` alias ran in every planandtier telemetry file recorded on 2026-09-28)
